name: plan-gemini-critique
about: #191: with the runner's gemini block on, a ready blueprint is critiqued by Gemini before its Approve button is posted. The engineering turn writes a 3-piece blueprint, ready; the fake agy (in the plan's directory, with the critique schema) raises 3 points (high missing on piece 1, medium order on piece 3, low risk on Risks); the runner resumes engineering's session with the points, and it takes 1 and 3 (revising the blueprint) and answers 2. The thread's reply opens with 'Gemini raised 3 points: 2 taken, 1 answered.', then the answers, the Approve blueprint v1 button and a link to the critique. The critique (points and answers) is the plan's critique v1; the blueprint v1 is the revised one. Approving it files the items as before.
